statement: The metric k-median approximation threshold and recovery. Gives a deterministic polynomial-time $`(1+2/e+\varepsilon)`$-approximation for finite rational metric k-median with specified candidate facilities, for every fixed ε > 0. Assuming $`P\ne NP`$, the optimal infimum approximation factor is $`1+2/e`$.
